evidence.title: Syracuse University Seeks to Prevent Campus Rape Victim From Obtaining Police Records

occurrences.checkable_against: Hearing transcript in Syracuse University subpoena litigation
occurrences.quote_span: At a hearing, John Powers, an attorney hired by the university, seemed to play to Lamendola’s previous role as a lawyer for the city of Syracuse, reminding the judge that the city is “inundated with [Freedom of Information Law] responses and subpoenas, and it’s incredibly burdensome on the city, I think, as you know in your experience as well.”
occurrences.speaker: John Powers
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Syracuse Police Department February 2026 brief and court docket
occurrences.quote_span: The police department then reversed its earlier position and joined in the motion, estimating in a February brief that it would take 845 hours and $50,000 in staff time to provide the documents Stengel had asked for and the police department lawyer had initially approved.
occurrences.speaker: Syracuse Police Department
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Syracuse County court docket and Syracuse Police Department records subpoena
occurrences.quote_span: After the Syracuse Police Department agreed to provide old records to the victim, lawyers for Syracuse University intervened, seeking to block the victim’s access to many of the records.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Andrew Stengel's police-records request and subpoena
occurrences.quote_span: Last year, Stengel asked the police department for all police calls and reports tied to a variety of crimes from 1982 to 1987 within the ZIP code that contains the university, Thornden Park, various businesses, and a mix of student and nonstudent housing.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Emails and Syracuse Police Department records-production documents
occurrences.quote_span: The two of them agreed on the terms in August 2025, and the police department began gathering the records shortly thereafter.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: University motion to partially quash and cited New York case law
occurrences.quote_span: Relying on case law that applies only to central and western New York state, university lawyers argued that it had standing to limit the request, even though it was not the recipient of Stengel’s subpoena.
occurrences.speaker: Syracuse University lawyers
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Syracuse County court docket and university motion to partially quash
occurrences.quote_span: A month later, the university filed a motion to “partially quash” the subpoena.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: City of Syracuse spokesperson statement
occurrences.quote_span: (A spokesperson said that “the City of Syracuse does not comment on ongoing litigation.”)
occurrences.speaker: City of Syracuse spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Judge Joseph Lamendola's February 2026 order
occurrences.quote_span: He also directed Syracuse University, the defendant in the case, to assist the Police Department in identifying cases that occurred on its campus.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Doe appellate brief and New York appellate court docket
occurrences.quote_span: Doe’s team filed a 37-page appellate brief in late June that argues that the court’s decision to limit the disclosure to university buildings is “hard to justify” given that the campus is interwoven with the city.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Syracuse University's third-party civil complaint against Michael McKinney
occurrences.quote_span: While McKinney was in jail, Syracuse University lawyers filed a civil complaint against him, arguing that if the university is held liable in Doe’s case, McKinney should “contribute to any award in an amount equal to his equitable share” because of “his own culpable conduct.”
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Judge Joseph Lamendola's February 2026 disclosure ruling
occurrences.quote_span: Under his ruling, none of the rapes that took place in Thornden Park or in the student apartments near it will have to be disclosed.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Hearing transcript and Syracuse city attorney records
occurrences.quote_span: The records were too old to be digitized, Powers told the judge, adding that, just as the judge once did, Powers represents the city in other matters.
occurrences.speaker: John Powers
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Michael Steinberg's appellate brief
occurrences.quote_span: The brief, authored by appellate attorney Michael Steinberg, also takes issue with the decision to allow university personnel to act as “gatekeepers,” authorizing them to review the police files and decide for themselves which meet the judge’s criteria and which don’t.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: University motion to partially quash subpoena
occurrences.quote_span: The university asserted that the subpoena would create unnecessary work for the police department, unearth irrelevant documents and waste the time of everyone involved.
occurrences.speaker: Syracuse University lawyers
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Judge Joseph Lamendola's February 2026 court ruling
occurrences.quote_span: New York state court Judge Joseph Lamendola ruled in the university’s favor in February, dramatically limiting the records the victim could obtain to make her case that the school should have beefed up security in response to escalating crime in the area.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Hearing transcript and Syracuse Police Department records-production plan
occurrences.quote_span: City employees, he said, would have to find them “the old way, Judge, the way we used to do it, crawling around in the dusty storeroom … trying to determine what ZIP code’s involved, looking at the crime. A lot of boxes, a lot of files. Very burdensome, very expensive for the city.”
occurrences.speaker: John Powers
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: New York state appellate court docket and briefing schedule
occurrences.quote_span: The university has until Sept. 23 to respond to the appeal.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Judge Joseph Lamendola's February 2026 order on subpoena scope
occurrences.quote_span: The police will have to disclose only reports of crimes that took place on the campus itself, and not reports concerning burglary, larceny and other offenses, which the judge deemed irrelevant.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: Syracuse University motion to partially quash subpoena
occurrences.quote_span: The school argued in legal papers that the subpoena sent to the police department was “overbroad” and suffered “from fatal geographic overreach” that rendered “it unreasonably burdensome and irrelevant.”
occurrences.speaker: Syracuse University lawyers
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: University motion for default and court docket
occurrences.quote_span: Because McKinney did not respond to the suit, the university lawyers have asked the judge to find him in default.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University

occurrences.checkable_against: New York state appellate court docket and notice of appeal
occurrences.quote_span: In June, her attorneys appealed that decision, sending the matter to a state appellate court.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Syracuse University
